promoted_source.title: Raportul de activitate al AJOFM Alba pentru anul 2025

observed_facts.training_design_statement: AJOFM Alba states that programmes were organised taking into account both employer requirements and the options/aptitudes of jobseekers.
observed_facts.digital_training_signal: Digital competences is listed among the occupations/programme areas with the most free training programmes for unemployed persons.
observed_facts.vacancy_structure_signal: The leading declared vacancies shown in the report are concentrated in commercial, unskilled and operational occupations rather than digital/AI-specific occupations.

promoted_source.claim_boundary: AJOFM-declared vacancies cover an administrative segment of the labour market and training programmes are institutional supply/response, not a representative measure of digital or AI skill-gap prevalence. The digital-course signal does not create H1-H5 points, and the non-digital vacancy mix does not prove absence of digital need.

secondary_research.research_boundary: Only source-exact official/institutional facts are registered. Training supply, project activity and inaccessible/unverified source bodies cannot establish need prevalence or change the respondent-derived H1-H5 numeric order.
